summary: Service-lane kerb where homes sit 0-5 m from every section.

best_section.where: Hawken Drive service lane south kerb, where a few cars park below the green-roofed house

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings at 0 m, 2 m, 4 m and 5 m (at 42, 62, 88, 110 and 117 m) front straight onto the kerb along the whole stretch.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow side lane beside the main carriageway; a few cars park on it, so a van could fit but takes a space residents use.
drivers.traffic: Slip lane beside a busy through road with a bus stop.
drivers.convention: 2P resident-permit signs on the lane; the cars parked there are residents'.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m along whole stretch
sun_shade: Partly shaded by trees on the south side; open to the north.
